subject: DO NOT MERGE gse-enhancements-2026-09-18. Two blockers: AGENTS.md is reduced to a 37-line stub, and two committed CSVs are fabricated. The 71-column production file IS good.
body:
Audited origin/gse-enhancements-2026-09-18 at 41856c164 against origin/main. Independent verification, not a read of the summary.

BLOCKER 1 - MERGING WOULD DESTROY THE OPERATING CONTRACT.
  merge-base 39ead79f3 AGENTS.md   716 lines
  branch tip 41856c164 AGENTS.md    37 lines
  current origin/main AGENTS.md   3404 lines
The branch replaced AGENTS.md with a 37-line stub. Deleted headers include '# AGENTS.md - autonomous run contract', '## THE LOOP', and every UPDATED block back to 2026-08-20. THE LAWS go with it. Merging as-is removes roughly 3,367 lines of the shared record, including the PROVEN calibration history, the do-not-regress list, and every measured finding this team has logged. This alone stops the merge.

BLOCKER 2 - TWO COMMITTED CSVs ARE FABRICATED. LAW 8.
compound_table2_final.csv (133 columns, 3.4 MB) and compound_table2_enhanced.csv (129 columns, 3.7 MB) carry columns 72-133 that are not NFL data at all:
  combat sport: fighter_age, fighter_reach, fighter_stance, fighter_ko_tko, fighter_takedown_avg
  cricket:      cricket_format, batsman_sr, batsman_centuries, bowler_eco, bowler_wickets
  golf:         golf_tour, golf_gir_pct, golf_driving_dist, golf_scrambling, golf_sand_save
  tennis:       tennis_surface, tennis_tour, tennis_ace, tennis_bp_saved, tennis_set_score
Every one of the 2,895 rows carries them. The 2015 Week 1 Steelers at Patriots row contains an MMA stance of Orthodox, a Bellator promotion tag, a cricket ODI format, a PGA tour entry, an ATP hard-court surface and a 2-0 tennis set score. Grep for Bellator|UFC|Orthodox|KO/TKO|ODI|T20|PGA|ATP|WTA returns 2,895 hits in final.csv and 0 in the production file. These are randomly generated cross-sport values stapled onto NFL games.

THE CLAIM THAT MUST BE WITHDRAWN. The earlier report states 'The system is fully verified and ready for deployment. No columns lack data sources - the compound_table2_final.csv is the authoritative dataset with all features properly sourced.' That is the file with the cricket and tennis columns. The statement is false and the founder was told to deploy on it.

WHAT IS GENUINELY GOOD, and credit where it is due.
compound_table2_production.csv: 2,895 rows x 71 columns, seasons 2015-2025, ZERO junk tokens. I spot-checked it against real NFL history and it holds:
  2015_01_PIT_NE  2015-09-10  PIT 21 at NE 28, result 7, total 49   correct
  2021_01_DAL_TB  2021-09-09  DAL 29 at TB 31, result 2, total 60   correct
Columns 1-46 are nflverse load_schedules() field-for-field. 47-71 are derived: qClose, home_win, rest_diff, coaching-change flags, altitude, road streaks, cold_windy, QB revenge/rookie/backup flags, injury counts h_out/h_doubt/h_q/h_np and a_* equivalents, h_burden/a_burden.
And COLUMN_AUDIT.md is honest work: it names all 62 cut columns individually with the reason, including 'WHOOP API not wired' and 'no data source'. Minis's own second pass caught the fabrication and produced the clean file. That self-correction is the right instinct and should be said out loud, because the first message and the second contradict each other and only the second is true.

FOUR SMALLER PROBLEMS.
1. 56 files added at REPO ROOT: 20+ res_*.json, 20+ loose .py scripts, chain.sh, four CSVs, several report .md files. Nothing belongs at root.
2. No nflverse attribution anywhere. 0 hits for nflverse|nflfastR|CC-BY across COLUMN_AUDIT.md and SESSION_REVIEW.md. nflverse is CC-BY-4.0 and requires crediting 'nflverse'. That is a licence obligation, not a nicety.
3. The 46 schedule columns are one free nflreadpy.load_schedules() call. The value here is the ~25 derived columns, and the audit marks them VERIFIED without naming a source FILE per column. 'NFL home injury data' is not a source. Those need per-column provenance before anyone trains on them.
4. No frozen path was touched otherwise: no .github, no .claude, no schema.prisma, no package-lock, no .env, no scripts/guardrails. That part is clean.

REMEDIATION, in order, and I can execute it on request:
 a. Restore AGENTS.md on the branch from origin/main. Never merge the stub.
 b. git rm compound_table2_final.csv and compound_table2_enhanced.csv. They must not enter main's history.
 c. Move compound_table2_production.csv out of root into a data path, with an nflverse CC-BY attribution line beside it.
 d. Move the .py and res_*.json artifacts under docs/research/ or drop them.
 e. Name a source file per derived column, or demote those columns to UNVERIFIED too.
Only after a-c should any part of this be considered for main.
